map.首月利息=贷款总额×月利率，月利率=年利率÷12。等额本息首期剩余本金即全额，故: First-month interest = total loan × monthly rate, where monthly rate = annual rate / 12. Under equal installments the first-period remaining principal is the full amount, so the first-month interest is highest and then declines monthly as principal is amortized.

map.为什么等额本息前期还的利息多？: Why is more interest paid early under equal installments?
map.等额本息每月月供固定，但利息按「剩余本金×月利率」计。还款初期剩余本金最高，利息: Equal installments keep the monthly payment fixed, but interest is charged on remaining principal × monthly rate. Early on the remaining principal is highest, so the interest share is largest; as principal is gradually amortized, the interest share falls and the principal share rises.
map.首月利息和次月利息差多少？: How much does the first-month interest differ from the second?
map.次月利息=次月剩余本金×月利率。次月剩余本金=首月本金−首月偿还的本金部分，因此: Second-month interest = second-month remaining principal × monthly rate. The second-month remaining principal = first-month principal − the principal portion repaid in the first month, so the second-month interest is slightly lower, by the first-month principal repayment × monthly rate.
